name: Dublin Pick 'N' Mix 2026

venue.name: Bracken Court Hotel
venue.address: 3A Bridge St, Balbriggan, Co. Dublin, K32 DK88

information:
# Please read the Pick 'N' Mix Competition Format tab before registering. You are only able to register for a few of the events available at this competition.

You will compete in one group, run, judge, or scramble in another group, and have time for a break in a third.
You MUST be present for the group you are helping out in otherwise you will **not** be allowed to compete.
